preconditions.description: The grid dimensions n and m must be between 1 and 500.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '.X' for row in grid for c in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the grid must be either '.' (unmarked) or 'X' (marked).

preconditions.expression: not any(grid[0][j] == 'X' or grid[n-1][j] == 'X' or grid[i][0] == 'X' or grid[i][m-1] == 'X' for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: No marked cells can be adjacent to the edge of the grid.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' or (stdout == 'YES' and all(c in '14' for row in grid for c in row if c != 'X'))
postconditions.description: If no suitable grid exists, output 'NO'. Otherwise, output 'YES' and ensure all unmarked cells contain either 1 or 4.

postconditions.expression: all((grid[i][j] == 'X' and sum(int(grid[x][y]) for x, y in neighbors if grid[x][y] != 'X') % 5 == 0) for i in range(n) for j in range(m) if grid[i][j] == 'X')
postconditions.description: Each marked cell must contain a multiple of 5, which is the sum of adjacent unmarked cells.
